| Base divisor $e$ | $f(e)$ | Sets containing these elements |
|:-:|:-:|:-:|

| 10 | 4 | $A_{10}, A_{50}, A_{250}$ |
| 25 | 20 | $A_{25}, A_{50}, A_{250}$ |
| 50 | 20 | $A_{50}, A_{250}$ |
| 125 | 100 | $A_{125}, A_{250}$ |
| 250 | 100 | $A_{250}$ |

Total: $1+1+4+4+20+20+100+100 = 250$ ✓

All 250 elements must have **distinct** positive integer values (since elements from different layers appear in common sets). To minimize $\sum m_d$ where $m_d = \max A_d$, I assign the smallest available values to layers that appear in the most $m_d$ computations.

$$\text{Layer order: } 1,\; 2,\; 5,\; 10,\; 25,\; 50,\; 125,\; 250$$

Assigning consecutive values:

| Layer | Values | Max $L_d$ |
|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| 1 | $\{1\}$ | 1 |
| 2 | $\{2\}$ | 2 |
| 5 | $\{3,4,5,6\}$ | 6 |
| 10 | $\{7,8,9,10\}$ | 10 |
| 25 | $\{11,\ldots,30\}$ | 30 |

| 125 | $\{51,\ldots,150\}$ | 150 |
| 250 | $\{151,\ldots,250\}$ | 250 |

**Verifying all constraints:** $L_1=1 \leq L_2=2 \leq L_{10}=10 \leq L_{50}=50 \leq L_{250}=250$ ✓, and $L_1=1 \leq L_5=6 \leq L_{25}=30 \leq L_{50}=50 \leq L_{250}=250$ ✓, and $L_{25}=30 \leq L_{125}=150 \leq L_{250}=250$ ✓.

$$m_1 = 1, \quad m_2 = \max(1,2) = 2, \quad m_5 = \max(1,6) = 6$$
$$m_{10} = \max(1,2,6,10) = 10, \quad m_{25} = \max(1,6,30) = 30$$
$$m_{50} = \max(1,2,6,10,30,50) = 50, \quad m_{125} = \max(1,6,30,150) = 150$$
$$m_{250} = 250$$

## Final Sum

$$\sum_{d \mid 250} \max A_d = 1 + 2 + 6 + 10 + 30 + 50 + 150 + 250 = \boxed{499}$$
